description: Referenzstationspunkte is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The 16 reference station points (RSP) currently distributed nationwide in Baden-Württemberg implement the uniform geodetic spatial reference. The realization with the help of geodetic reference values is based on the centrally prepared data of the RSP (SAPOS data). The geodetic reference values are demonstrated in AFIS. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Reference station points" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Messung, Höhe, Geodäsie, Geobasisdaten, SAPOS-Station, Referenzstation. The listing shows 2019-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
